name: Change Password
description: Allows an authenticated user with an existing password credential to prove the current password and submit a replacement password.

controls.name: Password Change Error
controls.visibilityCondition: The password-change submission or client-side password confirmation validation is rejected.

actions.name: Change Password
actions.visibilityCondition: The password-change form is valid for submission.

web.notes: Canonical authenticated password-change surface; implementation will be reconciled against the web client during Presentation/Implementation review.

mobile.notes: Must expose the same fields, validation semantics, error status, and submit action as the web surface.

notes: A failed server submission remains on this view and presents status:password-change-error.
Confirm-password mismatch is presentation validation and should prevent a server password-change attempt.
